title: WebSocket Collaborative Editor
description: Build a collaborative document editing server with version history, supporting REST CRUD operations.

steps.title: Create a document
steps.description: Create a POST /documents endpoint that accepts title and content, assigns an id, and returns 201 with the document.
hints: Use app.post('/documents', handler) with express.json() middleware
Generate a unique id for each document
Include version history array initialized with the first version

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class DocumentIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    content: str

documents = {}
next_id = 1
version_counter = 1

@app.post('/documents', status_code=201)
def create_doc(doc: DocumentIn):
    global next_id, version_counter
    doc_id = next_id
    next_id += 1
    documents[doc_id] = {
        'id': doc_id,
        'title': doc.title,
        'content': doc.content,
        'versions': [{'id': version_counter, 'content': doc.content, 'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()}]
    }
    version_counter += 1
    return documents[doc_id]
